title: It’s ok
text: It’s ok. The shelves bend easily and the drawers are not great for everyday use. Pulling them out every day is kind of annoying because you have to hold the back of the item to shut the drawer.

product_metadata.title: Pipishell Hanging Closet Organizer 6-Shelf, Hanging Shelves for Closet with 3 Removable Drawers & Side Pockets, Hanging Shelf Organizer for Bedroom or Garment Rack, 12'' x 12'' x 43.3'', Dark Gray
features: PRACTICAL CLOSET ORGANIZER: The Pipishell hanging closet organizer with drawers uses the vertical space in your closet to maximize capacity. The contemporary fabric and stylish color fits in well with any design style and aesthetic.

3 REMOVABLE DRAWERS: The closet organizer and storage includes 3 removable drawers that fit inside or can be used separately for storage. 3 mesh pockets are located on the outside of the organizer for small items and clothing.

DURABLE MATERIAL: The non-woven material is durable with an MDF upper and lower panel for structure. The steel triangle-shaped hooks make it easy to hang the unit on a standard closet rod and help to provide strength.

VERTICAL STORAGE SAVES SPACE: The closet organizer hanging shelves measure 12” x 12” x 43.3” in size. Easily fit multiple organizers in a standard closet space. The foldable design makes it easy to store the organizer when not in use.

UPGRADE YOUR CLOSET: Quickly organize sweaters, shirts, pants, handbags, purses, shoes, and hats to make the most of your closet space. The portable closet organizer is also a great solution to store children’s clothing and toys.
